ev.text: When all this is quieter, what will you do?
No traders on the west road in days.
Word has got round about our nights, I expect.
Sleep for a week. Then, who knows? You?
The same, I think. But it is good to wonder.
Then we shall have to make do with our own company.
When all this is quieter, what will you do?
Sleep for a week. Then, who knows? You?
The same, I think. But it is good to wonder.

entry.text: Brenna and Vex have tonight's watch.
